name: io.github.tonyyang0504/reverb-mcp
description: Reverb (ecommerce channels): me, update_listing, set_inventory, end_listing, list_orders, mark_shipp

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_REVERB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Reverb Personal Access Token (My Profile > API & Integrations > Generate New Token) with scopes public, read_listings, write_listings, read_orders, write_orders; personal tokens do not expire. Sent as Authorization: Bearer.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_REVERB_CURRENCY
environmentVariables.description: Currency of your listing prices, e.g. USD; required when update_listing sends a price.
